items.title: Theodore Purnell Interview, 1972-06-16
items.q: The damnest man I ever played with in my life was Lee Collins.

ctx.x: Good bands, boy. That guy could play.

Very young, boy. Could he play blues? Play anything, man. He was a good band boy. That guy could play. Very young boy. Could he play blues? Play anything man. He could play anything. The damnest man I ever played with in my life was Lee Collins.
